doc: One row of two texels, threshold at the shield edge: the smallest legal shape. Float32 fields, streak and subtexel arrays. Arguments: s, fine, thr, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads plus sensitivity_step. The floor 0.05 is a literal of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 5.7e-9; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.5e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 56x the larger of the two spreads.
